supersedes.reason: A pre-observation audit found that forcing Direct3D 12 did not bind or immutably record the adapter selected by egui-wgpu. The product now uses native_adapter_selector to require one matching physical Direct3D 12 adapter, and the NAV harness records its AdapterInfo. All thresholds, corpora, expected outcomes, hardware profiles, oracles, and consequences remain unchanged.

inherited_contract: All thresholds, corpora, expected outcomes, hardware profiles, oracles, consequences, license policy, toolchain evidence, OCCT inputs, and non-NAV measurement sources are inherited byte-for-byte from r0-v11. Only the frozen product adapter selection and NAV evidence source change.
immutability_rule: Any listed byte change after the first r0-v12 Gate C observation fails the run. A replacement requires a new freeze_id and report; historical r0-v9, r0-v10, and r0-v11 evidence remains unchanged.
